verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm, so a self-serve O-1/EB-1 eligibility qualifier on its site is a fair question. The evidence shows a startups practice, an O-1 practice page and the Visalaw AI product, but no free structured eligibility check or assessment tool for founders. The Visalaw AI free trial is a drafting and research tool for immigration teams, not a founder self-assessment, so it earns no credit.
